answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks when every new identity must lock a refundable deposit in a shared vault before it can trade: the stake is held while the newcomer climbs a reputation ridge one verified job at a time, each receipt hash-linked to the last, and independent peers audit the chain from a terrace above the ledger. One forged receipt breaks the chain and slashes the deposit, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand deposits and a thousand verified jobs — forgery pays less than honest work.
